section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测装置，由底座、传送机构、储存箱、观察机构和废料池组成，所述底座、传送机构、储存箱、观察机构和废料池都安装在底座上方的工作台面上，储存箱在传送机构左端，废料池在传送机构右端且位于右转轴的下方，所述传送机构包括左转轮、右转轮、左转轴、右转轴和皮带，左转轮和右转轮之间通过皮带连接，皮带上设置检测样品座，左转轮和右转轮后端连接电机，电机安装在固定块上。本实用新型一方面通过传送装置使检测流程化，提高检测效率；另一方面通过相应的滑轮结构，方便装置的移动。

The utility model discloses a biological gene detection device, which consists of a base, a transmission mechanism, a storage box, an observation mechanism and a waste material pool, wherein the base, the transmission mechanism, the storage box, the observation mechanism and the waste material pool are all arranged on a working table surface above the base, the storage box is arranged at the left end of the transmission mechanism, the waste material pool is arranged at the right end of the transmission mechanism and is positioned below a right rotating shaft, the transmission mechanism comprises a left rotating wheel, a right rotating wheel, a left rotating shaft, a right rotating shaft and a belt, the left rotating wheel and the right rotating wheel are connected through the belt, a detection sample seat is arranged on the belt, the rear ends of the left rotating wheel and the right rotating wheel are connected with a motor, and the motor is arranged on a fixed block. On one hand, the utility model makes the detection process through the conveying device, thereby improving the detection efficiency; on the other hand, the device is convenient to move through a corresponding pulley structure.

Biological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological detection, in particular to a biological gene detection device.

Background

Gene testing is the basis for providing the examinees and medical researchers with the assessment of some diseases, constitutions or personal traits related to genetic inheritance from chromosome structure, DNA sequence, DNA variation sites or gene expression levels. The gene sample and gene detection reagent required in gene detection have high requirements on storage environment and need to be in a constant-temperature and sterile environment. When the gene detection device is used for batch detection, the conventional gene detection device cannot perform constant-temperature sterile storage on batch gene samples and gene detection reagents, so that the gene sequencing is inaccurate, and the gene samples and the gene detection reagents are wasted.

The gene detection device with the application number of CN201811242672.8 comprises a workbench, a gene sample storage mechanism, a reagent storage mechanism, a gene detection mechanism and a controller, wherein the gene sample storage mechanism, the reagent storage mechanism, the gene detection mechanism and the controller are sequentially arranged on the workbench; the controller is respectively electrically connected with the gene sample storage mechanism, the reagent storage mechanism and the gene detection mechanism. When the kit is used for batch detection, the batch gene samples and the gene detection reagent can be aseptically stored at constant temperature, and when a worker takes out a single gene sample, the storage environment of other gene samples is not influenced, so that the gene samples and the gene detection reagent caused by the storage environment are avoided, and the gene sequencing result is greatly improved; in addition, even if the worker is not around the gene detection device, the worker can receive the detection result through the wireless communication module.

Above-mentioned utility model carries out gene detection time measuring again and has detected to every detection sample and need change the washing, then carries out next operation, and time consumption is many, and efficiency is not high. In addition, the detection sample is not classified by a corresponding treatment pool after detection is finished, so that the detection sample is easy to spill, and the device is inconvenient to move.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Based on the technical problems in the background art, the utility model provides a biological gene detection device, which realizes detection process through a conveying device and improves detection efficiency; on the other hand, the device is convenient to move through a corresponding pulley structure.

The utility model provides a biological gene detection device, which consists of a base, a conveying mechanism, a storage box, an observation mechanism and a waste material pool, wherein the base, the conveying mechanism, the storage box, the observation mechanism and the waste material pool are all arranged on a workbench surface above the base, the storage box is arranged at the left end of the conveying mechanism, the waste material pool is arranged at the right end of the conveying mechanism and is positioned below a right rotating shaft, the conveying mechanism comprises a left rotating wheel, a right rotating wheel, a left rotating shaft, a right rotating shaft and a belt, the left rotating wheel and the right rotating wheel are connected through the belt, a detection sample seat is arranged on the belt, the rear ends of the left rotating wheel and the right rotating wheel are connected with a motor, and the motor is arranged on a fixed block.

Further, the bin is inside by interior reagent tube socket, fixed plate, round hole layer and storage box wall outside to in proper order, and temperature regulation apparatus installs the right-hand member inside the bin, be equipped with the rubber sleeve between reagent tube socket and the fixed plate.

Furthermore, the lower end of the base is provided with a clamping groove sheet and a driving wheel, two ends of the driving wheel are provided with driving wheel shaft seats, and two sides of each driving wheel shaft seat are arranged on the clamping groove sheet through rotating upright posts.

Further, the observation mechanism comprises a sleeve, a vertical upright, a transverse upright and an observation module.

The biological gene detection device provided by the utility model has the advantages that: the lug is used for facilitating the installation of the workbench on the groove, the height of the workbench can be adjusted through the matching of the cylinder and the ejector rod, and different personnel can adjust the height conveniently according to the requirements; in addition, the device uses a rotatable lamp, so that the detection requirement is convenient.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more apparent, the present invention is further described in detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the utility model and are not intended to limit the utility model.

Referring to fig. 1, the bio-gene detection device provided by the utility model comprises a base 100, a transmission mechanism 200, a storage box 300, an observation mechanism 400 and a waste material pool 500, wherein the base 100, the transmission mechanism 200, the storage box 300, the observation mechanism 400 and the waste material pool 500 are all installed on a worktable 105 above the base 100, the storage box 300 is arranged at the left end of the transmission mechanism 200, the waste material pool 500 is arranged at the right end of the transmission mechanism 200 and is positioned below a right rotating shaft 205-1, the transmission mechanism 200 comprises a left rotating wheel 202, a right rotating wheel 203, a left rotating shaft 205, a right rotating shaft 205-1 and a belt 201, the left rotating wheel 202 and the right rotating wheel 203 are connected through the belt 201, a detection sample seat 206 is arranged on the belt 201, the rear ends of the left rotating wheel 202 and the right rotating wheel 203 are connected with a motor 204, and the motor 204 is installed on a fixed block 207.

Referring to fig. 3, the inside of the storage box 300 is provided with a reagent tube groove 304, a fixing plate 306, a round hole layer 303 and a storage box wall 302 in sequence from inside to outside, a temperature adjusting device 301 is installed at the right end of the inside of the storage box 300, and a rubber sleeve 305 is arranged between the reagent tube groove 304 and the fixing plate 306. The reagent tube used for detection is placed in the reagent tube groove 304, the test tube is placed in the reagent tube groove 304 more stably through the rubber sleeve 305, the fixing plate 306 and the storage box wall 302 both play a role in protecting the reagent tube, the temperature adjusting device 301 cools and heats the interior of the storage box 300, the temperature evenly conveys the reagent tube through the round hole layer 303, the temperature cannot be increased or decreased sharply, and damage to a detection sample in the reagent tube is protected.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, the lower end of the base 100 is provided with a slot sheet 102 and a driving wheel 101, two ends of the driving wheel 101 are provided with a driving wheel axle seat 103, and two sides of the driving wheel axle seat 103 are mounted on the slot sheet 102 through a rotating upright post 104. The driving wheel shaft 101 is installed on the slot sheet 102 through the rotating upright posts 104 on both sides, and then the slot sheet 102 is installed on the base 100, so that the driving wheel 101 is more convenient to install and disassemble on one hand, and the driving wheel 101 is guaranteed to rotate at multiple angles on the other hand.

The viewing mechanism 400 includes a sleeve 401, a vertical post 402, a transverse post 403, and a viewing module 404. Vertical column 402 is installed and can rotate in sleeve 401, has made things convenient for observation module 404 to rotate, and observation module 404 can carry out the collection of gene testing data through the sample of enlargeing detection sample seat 206.

The utility model provides a biological gene detection device, at first take out the reagent pipe of placing in storage box 300 during the operation, put into the test sample seat 206 with the test sample in the reagent pipe according to actual need, then open motor 204, motor 204 rotates and makes left-hand turn 202 and right-hand turn 20 rotate, left-hand turn 202 and right-hand turn 20 drive belt 201 and rotate, the test sample seat 206 of setting on belt 201 gets into observation module 404 below in proper order, obtain gene detection's information through observation module 404, thereby accomplish the detection.

The above description is only for the preferred embodiment of the present invention, but the scope of the present invention is not limited thereto, and any person skilled in the art should be considered to be within the technical scope of the present invention, and equivalent alternatives or modifications according to the technical solution of the present invention and the inventive concept thereof should be covered by the scope of the present invention.
